factions.name: Cold Harbor Solutions Group
factions.source: BPRE Cold Harbor & Aayari Covenant (project doc)
factions.notes: Stellex-contracted PMC. Tier 1 operators, Tier 2 Crisis Troop Scorch, Tier 3 Nitto 00 Unit and SPEAR Brigade. Expect 8–14 figures against 16–25.

rules.name: Tier 1 Professionalism
rules.text: Tier 1 operators never rout and auto-pass morale. If the last Tier 1 operator dies, Tier 2/3 units test morale at −1.

rules.name: Fire and Movement
rules.text: When a Cold Harbor unit fires and another moves in the same phase, the moving unit gets +1 to its armor save for that activation.

rules.name: CQB Doctrine
rules.text: Operators and Scorch: +1 Combat fighting inside buildings or enclosed structures.

rules.name: Drone Network
rules.text: With an Advisor or Enabler in the force, friendly units within 12" of the Advisor may re-roll failed Reaction tests once per round.

rules.name: Night Vision
rules.text: Operators and Scorch ignore darkness penalties; Nitto and SPEAR halve them (round down).

rules.name: Mixed Force
rules.text: May mix all three tiers in one platoon; a Tier 1 character must lead.

rules.name: Suppressed [C]
rules.text: Enemies may not Reaction-fire at the attacker; shots after the first in an activation are −1 to hit.

rules.name: One Use [C]
rules.text: Used once per battle.

factions.name: The Aayari Covenant
factions.source: BPRE Cold Harbor & Aayari Covenant (project doc)
factions.notes: Fanatical insurgent network aligned with the ASL, supplied through Hongbin Alloy. Field 20–30% more points than a Cold Harbor opponent, and plenty of terrain.

rules.name: Fanaticism
rules.text: Aayari Guard pass morale on 3+ and never retreat; a failed check Pins instead.

rules.name: Expendable Masses
rules.text: Up to 6 Troop choices per platoon; Shurta squads do not count toward support or specialist limits.

rules.name: Improvised Explosives
rules.text: Before deployment place D3+1 IED tokens. Enemy within 3": detonate, 4+ to hit, Damage 2, Area, Piercing. A Muhtasib Sapper within 12" and LoS may command-detonate.

rules.name: Proxy Warfare
rules.text: Hongbin Alloy units may be taken as support choices; with Hongbin present the force gains Drone Strike.

rules.name: Ambush Tactics
rules.text: After deployment, up to 2 Shurta squads may use Hidden Deployment.

rules.name: Decentralized Command
rules.text: No morale penalty for a leader's death; without a Hongbin Enabler on the table, no coordinated activations.

factions.name: Hongbin Alloy
factions.source: BPRE Cold Harbor & Aayari Covenant (project doc) + Errata E-1
factions.notes: Mercenary cutout for Hegemonic Authority intelligence. Professionals: standard morale, withdraw rather than die. Rank-and-file use the Military profile per Errata E-1.

rules.name: Professional Soldier
rules.text: Hongbin do not use Aayari Fanaticism; standard morale.

rules.name: Errata E-1
rules.text: Rank-and-file: Reaction 2, Combat +1, Training +1, Toughness 4, 6+ save. Points provisional (+5 per figure).

factions.name: Ad Servitutem Liberandum
factions.notes: Cell-based insurgents. Civilian profile, Toughness 3, KP 1. Proxied by Star Wars Legion Rebel Troopers in Feuertaufe.

rules.name: Cell Structure
rules.text: Eliminated leaders are replaced; units do not break from leader casualties.

rules.name: Urban Fighters
rules.text: +1 Combat in buildings and ruins.

rules.name: Improvised Explosives
rules.text: D3 IED tokens may be placed before battle.

rules.name: Fanaticism
rules.text: Pass morale on 3+ and never retreat; fight to the last model. (Feuertaufe: a failed check Pins.)

factions.name: Steel Lions Mercenary Company
factions.notes: Squad profiles live in the Fringe Detachment campaign chat and are not in this pack yet.

rules.name: Mercenary Professionals
rules.text: Re-roll one failed morale check per battle.

rules.name: Flexible Tactics
rules.text: May change one unit's mission role at the start of battle.

rules.name: Veteran Instincts
rules.text: Units with 3+ campaign experience may react once on the enemy turn.

factions.name: 78th Sturm Battalion
factions.notes: Eisenwald redemption battalion. Roster and templates come from the example data.

rules.name: Iron Discipline
rules.text: Never routs; auto-pass morale checks.

rules.name: Siege Veterans
rules.text: +1 Combat in prepared positions or urban terrain.

rules.name: Artillery Support
rules.text: Any squad can call off-table artillery once per battle.

rules.name: Redemption Through Sacrifice
rules.text: Once per battle: +2 Combat for one turn, but damage taken ignores armor.

factions.name: Solarii Auxiliaries
factions.notes: Professional mercenary Tercios from Anchor Primus. Composition: at least two Auxiliaris squads; one officer per two Auxiliaris/Veteran squads (Tribune or higher at 750+); one vehicle per 300 pts; one named character per 500 pts. Encounter: roll the Solarii Disposition D6 (1 Contract Opposition, 2 Neutral Observers, 3 Parallel Objective, 4 Contracted Alliance, 5 CARDINAL Complication, 6 Request for Assistance) and keep a Relationship Track from 0.

rules.name: Void-Sealed (Lorica Protocol)
rules.text: Immune to hostile atmosphere, radiation and similar hazards. Solarii infantry cannot Dash.

rules.name: Fire Discipline
rules.text: A unit that fires without moving may reroll one failed Hit die (not if suppressed).

rules.name: Integrity of Formation
rules.text: No Suppression penalties while an unsuppressed officer is within 6". At 50% or fewer figures, Training test 5+ at next activation or fall back 3".

rules.name: Methodical Advance
rules.text: Designate a Primary Fire Position: units there get +1 Training and −1 activation cost (min 1).

rules.name: Combined Arms Coordination
rules.text: A vehicle firing at a target Solarii infantry fired on this round ignores its Cover bonus.

rules.name: Tercio Pride
rules.text: When the first unit is lost, units that can see where it fell gain +1 Training for the battle.

rules.name: Lorica Coordination
rules.text: Infantry within 8" of an unsuppressed officer may use the officer's Training for Morale tests.

rules.name: Weapon traits
rules.text: Reliable / Unreliable, Anti-Armor (Light), Limited Ammo (n), Crewed (n), Requires Setup, Powerful — as defined in the Solarii document.

factions.name: Aeldari Remnant
factions.notes: Craftworlds Il-Kaithe (heavy weapons, monitoring the Necron awakening), Saim-Hann (fast raiders in the Shatter) and Ulthwé (manipulators; Farseer Taldris). Campaign hooks: The Convergence, The Debt Unpaid, The Lost Exodite, The Psychic Storm.

rules.name: Ancient Doom
rules.text: Immune to non-psychic Fear; in melee with Necrons, Training test or −1 Combat.

rules.name: Battle Focus
rules.text: Infantry may fire after Running or Dashing at −1 to Hit (not Heavy weapons).

rules.name: Fleet of Foot
rules.text: +2" when Running instead of +1".

rules.name: Psychic Race
rules.text: Enemy psykers −1 targeting Aeldari; Aeldari psykers +1 (not Wraith constructs).

rules.name: Superior Senses
rules.text: Cannot be surprised; ignore the first −1 from Limited Visibility.

rules.name: Shuriken
rules.text: Natural 6 to Hit auto-wounds and ignores armor.

rules.name: Monofilament
rules.text: Damage rolled against Reactions instead of Toughness.

rules.name: Melta
rules.text: At half range or less, +1 to the damage multiplier.

rules.name: Spirit-Guided
rules.text: Ignore cover penalties.

rules.name: Wraithweapon
rules.text: Target passes Training at −2 or is removed; vehicles take D3 damage.

rules.name: Psi-Weapon
rules.text: Psyker adds Savvy to damage; Piercing vs psykers.

rules.name: Prism / Resonance / Paired / Drop Attack / Auto-Hit
rules.text: As defined in the Aeldari Remnant document §2.2.

rules.name: Aeldari Vehicles
rules.text: Grav-Vehicle, Elegant Design (−1 to be hit after moving half Speed), Crystal Matrix (fire all weapons).

rules.name: Serpent Shield
rules.text: Damage 1 or less ignored on 5+; once per game discharge (24", D6+6 shots, Dmg 1, ignores cover), then the passive is lost.

rules.name: Casting Powers
rules.text: Spend Psi Points, roll 1D6+Savvy, 5+ succeeds; natural 1 = 1 Hit to the psyker. Regain half max Psi each turn. Each power once per turn per psyker.

rules.name: Runes of Fate (Farseer)
rules.text: Guide (1): reroll missed attacks · Doom (2): enemy −1 saves · Fortune (2): friendly +1 saves · Mind War (2): Savvy duel · Eldritch Storm (3): 6" radius, Dmg 1 Piercing · Executioner (2): 3 Hits Dmg 1 Focused.

rules.name: Runes of Battle
rules.text: Conceal/Reveal (1) · Protect/Jinx (2) · Quicken/Restrain (2) · Embolden/Horrify (1/2) · Spirit Link (1, Spiritseer).
